# Settings surface: map

**Owns:** Settings: Skills (the library, Review, Write and Upload) and Office limits (the desks, from Work, and the Context policy's size threshold, from Conversations) and Appearance (the palette, or following the system, kept in this browser by `useAppearance` from `packages/ui`). It reads the service through `src/api/` (see [the web app's map](../../MAP.md)).
